description: Upload a local PDF (text or scanned), DOCX, EPUB or image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, TIFF, BMP, GIF) to PageTranslate and get the exact price to translate it. Uploading is free and does not start or charge anything. Returns job_id, word count, price and what to do next. Max 100 MB and 1,000 PDF pages; uploads are rate limited per account.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer.

target_language.description: Language code to translate into, e.g. es, fr, de, it, ja, ko, ar, hi, ru. Special codes: pt (Portugal) or pt-BR (Brazil), zh (Simplified) or zh-TW (Traditional), fil (Filipino), no (Norwegian).

name: upload_document
title: Upload a document and get a translation quote
